sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation permits a self-referential infinite list, and only the demanded head is evaluated.
sketches.resonance: A life can be endless in structure while the present asks for only one breath.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because no sender can ever rendezvous with it.
sketches.resonance: The program waits faithfully for a reply from a relation that was never made.

sketches.mechanism: The never return type is satisfied by code paths that cannot complete normally, such as an infinite loop.
sketches.resonance: Some promises are kept only by never arriving.
